checks.description: Discovering supported operations, feature entry points, and known values through IntelliSense and documentation. Inspect existing ActivityTypes constants alongside string-valued activity APIs before considering additive typed helpers.
Readability of typical caller code, descriptive names, parameter ordering, return values, and repeated setup. Propose concrete reductions in caller effort with before/after examples.
Consistency across MSTeams feature areas, async naming, cancellation, overloads, fluent builders and declarative attributes. Preserve existing signatures, overload resolution, and attribute usage.
Known string values, optional data, typed access and conversions. Improve discoverability while preserving custom/unknown values, null handling, existing property types and exact serialized values.

Routing, generated entry points, contexts, model helpers and Teams client access. Inspect source generators and existing extension points. Avoid introducing competing entry points or Teams-specific behavior in shared projects.
XML documentation, examples and onboarding paths for existing APIs. Identify specific gaps or misleading patterns and give a concrete compatible documentation or example improvement.
